# Selected additional-BSI count producer

Scope: ordinary non-bypass wrapper; selected codec selector value 10; selected 48 kHz, 1024 kbps profile; one configured substream. The result below defines the selected scalar and its copy path. It is not an ID14 parser or an ID14 semantic definition.

## Count source

The wrapper receives a rate code and a list of signed I16 channel-label codes. The supported observed construction domain is list length 1..128 and rate code 0..5. For this construction path:

```text
lfe_present = 1 iff any channel_code >= 0 and ((channel_code >> 8) & 127) == 4
non_lfe_count = 11 if rate_code == 0 else 15
configured_count_i32 = non_lfe_count + lfe_present
```

The count is integer arithmetic. Multiple LFE-coded labels still yield the Boolean value 1. Negative channel codes do not match the LFE predicate. The selected native run has rate code 5 and 38 channel-label entries, of which the observed shape path identifies one LFE label: `15 + 1 = 16`. This is a wrapper/configuration count, not the ADM input-channel count and not an ID14 parser projection. Other rate-code cases are helper/control coverage, not support for alternate complete codec profiles.

The selected configuration record carries a signed I32 count. Its constructor accepts 1..16, defaults to 11 when absent, and returns error 220 for explicit values outside that range. Validation occurs after the header/selector prefix is written; on the tested invalid cases the target count slot remains unchanged and the tail canary is intact, but the prefix has changed. Do not promise whole-object rollback. Valid explicit endpoints 1 and 16 pass. An absent parameter produces 11.

## Additional-BSI producer and import

For the selected one-substream path, the producer writes U16 enable=1 and U16 length-minus-one=1. Starting from the caller's prior U8[64] payload, it writes byte 0 to 1 and byte 1 to `configured_count_i32 & 255`; bytes 2..63 are preserved. Within the validated 1..16 domain, this low-byte conversion does not truncate a legal value. The importer copies the U16 enable, U16 length and all 64 payload bytes literally into its working header.

The selected producer uses the same constructed configuration record and the imported record is joined to the corresponding producer record. Controlled valid values 1 and 16 produce prefixes 0101 and 0110 and survive the full 64-byte import copy. The natural selected run produces count 16. A native zero tail was observed, but this package does not establish its earliest initializer; model the two generated bytes and preserve the existing tail according to the owning state contract rather than inventing a 64-byte all-zero producer.

Calls without the native option context returned 35 after writing BSI bytes in earlier controlled observations. This is partial-mutation evidence, not an input-validity result and not an ID14 parser failure. Validation-bypassed probes for 17, 272 and -1 only document the underlying low-byte conversion and are not accepted configuration values.
